g.text: "You are evaluating the results of a neutron reflectivity fit."

Range has been auto-expanded for the next fit.

A fit with χ² within this threshold should be marked "acceptable": true.

text.tspan: **Acceptance floor: χ² ≥ 0.5.** … your verdict alone decides

AuRE's sentence for a slot nobody filled: sent as written, whatever the fit was
aure/nodes/prompts.py · FIT_EVALUATION_PROMPT · format_fit_evaluation_prompt()

g.text: no selection: the whole installed set is sent
≈189 KB on a fresh project (19 skills),
≈223 KB after nrw skills sync (23 skills)
most of a prompt of about 230 KB
the frozen spec's stack also gives n_layers
info.converged → converged (unknown is sent as No)
every best-fit value, by parameter name
BIC and the free-parameter count → Model Complexity
every other finding stays in the report, unsent:
residuals, layers thinner than their interfaces …
each renders AuRE's own placeholder sentence,
in grey in the prompt. They were written for
AuRE's loop and are sent as they are.
chi2_min ← CHI2_MIN, 0.5 when it is unset
from the first { to the last } in the reply → json.loads
no parseable JSON → AuRE's _simple_evaluation(), a χ² heuristic,
written up in NOTES.md as the model's verdict all the same; only
a raised error → AureUnavailableError → one "Not checked" line
next_action and the hypothesis id route AuRE's own loop;
nr-workbench keeps them in the JSON and shows neither
issue: CuOx.rho sits on its lower bound
appended: "### What a language model made of it" —
quality, issues, physical concerns, suggestions, and
in an HTML comment: "It has not seen the data. Treat it
as a reviewer's first pass, not a result."
the whole verdict under "judgement", for nrw report

svg.text: WHEN NO MODEL IS ASKED · the arithmetic checks still run and are still written
NRW_AGENT=1 · a harness is driving
No call. The harness is the better model, and a second
verdict handed back would read as evidence. Instead:
"Judge these values yourself: are they
physically sensible for this sample …"
--no-llm
Only the arithmetic checks, by request.
no endpoint configured
"No language-model endpoint configured, so
nothing judged whether these values are
physically sensible." — and how to set one up
no chi-squared recorded
"No chi-squared recorded, so the fit could
not be judged." AuRE formats χ² with :.3f,
so a missing one would raise.
